help_settings_guide: 1. How to Generate Voice (Voice Studio) • Tap 🎙️ Text → Voice → Clone from the main menu. • Choose your desired base voice and model. • Send the text script you want to convert into speech (or voice note). • The AI will synthesize studio-quality speech in seconds! 2. Balances & Account Tiers • FREE Tier: Includes {free_min} free minutes ({free_sec}s) every monthly cycle. Up to {char_free} characters per generation, and up to {daily_limit} generations per day. • PURCHASED Tier: Extended up to {char_purchased} characters per generation, access to exclusive VIP models, priority processing, unlimited daily generations, and non-expiring minutes. 3. Earn Free Minutes (Refer & Earn) • Tap 🎁 Refer & Earn to get your personal invite link. • Earn +30 seconds for each friend who joins (up to 10 minutes total reward). 4. Language Settings • Use the buttons below to switch your preferred language at any time.
